items.title: 10.10.1 1 mole electrons par charge maloom karna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.10.1 with Figure 10.2, printed page 223.

blocks.text: 1 mole electrons ka charge Figure 10.2 ke apparatus se ek saade electrolytic tajurbe se milta hai. Khalis copper anode aur khalis copper cathode alag alag tole jate hain aur aabi copper(II) sulfate ki electrolysis ke liye tarteeb diye jate hain. Variable resistor current ko taqreeban 0.2 amperes par mustaqil rakhta hai, aur mustaqil current napi hui muddat, misal ke taur par 40 minutes, guzara jata hai. Cathode aur anode nikal kar distilled water aur phir propanone se dhoye aur sukhaye aur dobara tole jate hain. Cathode ki mass barhti hai kyunke copper jama hota hai; anode ki mass ghat-ti hai kyunke copper copper ions ke taur par solution mein jata hai. Anode ki mass ki kami napi jati hai, kyunke copper hamesha cathode se achhi tarah nahi chipakta.

blocks.alt: Copper(II) sulfate ki electrolysis ka circuit. Battery (baen taraf +) ammeter ke zariye baen copper anode se juri hai (taar par teer anode ki taraf), aur variable resistor ke zariye daen copper cathode se. Dono copper electrodes beaker mein CuSO4 (aq) solution mein doobe hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.2: Jama hone wale copper ki mass ka hisab lagane ka apparatus (kitab ki Figure 10.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

rows: khalis copper anode aur cathode, pehle aur baad tole hue
taqreeban 0.2 A, variable resistor se mustaqil, napi hui muddat ke liye
anode ki mass ki kami (copper Cu2+ ke taur par halta hai)

blocks.prompt: Cathode ke izafe ke bajaye anode ki mass ki kami ko kyun tarjeeh di jati hai, aur electrodes propanone se kyun dhoye jate hain?
blocks.explanation: Jama copper dheela ho sakta hai aur cathode se jhar sakta hai, to us ka izafa qabil-e-bharosa nahi, jabke anode bilkul utna copper khota hai jitna hala. Propanone pani ko hata kar jaldi ur jata hai, to electrodes garam kiye baghair sookh jate aur baqi pani ke baghair tole jate hain.

items: Copper electrodes tolein; CuSO4(aq) ko mustaqil 0.2 A par napi muddat electrolyse karein; pani aur propanone se dhoein, sukhayein aur dobara tolein; anode ki mass ki kami istemal karein.
